Ch.6 "Relationships, Causation, and Hidden Structures" — planned seven sections: 6.1 scatterplots and visual association; 6.2 the correlation coefficient (range -1 to +1, scale- invariance, measures direction and strength only, NOT causation — heavy caveats in dedicated subheading); 6.3 the causation trap: why association never implies causation, introduced via confounding variables and the ladder from observation to experiment; 6.4 Simpson's Paradox as a capstone: when a statistic reverses direction upon subgrouping — needs a vivid, memorable applied example (UC Berkeley admissions or a health-outcome analogue) with explicit walkthrough showing how the paradox operates; 6.5 the false safety of a single correlation number; 6.6 connecting to public-health capstone dataset — what relationships between variables the reader can now legitimately ask about; 6.7 chapter summary with explicit forward cross-ref to Ch.7. Ch.7 "The Evidence in Practice" — planned eight sections building around a single public-health indicators dataset (WHO/Gapminder style): 7.1 dataset description and variable taxonomy (calling back to Ch.1 vocabulary: variable types, units, frequency); 7.2–7.3 variable-by-variable distributions and visual summaries (Ch.2–3 methods — center, spread, shape); 7.4–7.5 connecting regions and subgroups through cross-distribution comparison using confidence intervals from Ch.5; 7.6 cautious exploration of relationships: correlations, warnings about confounding, Simpson's-paradox-style checks; 7.7 synthesis chapter that threads all prior chapters through one dataset so the reader sees descriptive statistics, benchmark comparison, uncertainty quantification, and relationship-analysis as one coherent toolkit; 7.8 closing: what the student carries forward — the discipline of describing full distributions, weighing uncertainty, and refusing to let single-number claims pass unexamined. Notation continuity: bold on first definition, named/numbered worked examples, explicit forward/backward cross-references. Public-health dataset should illustrate life expectancy, infant mortality, health expenditure, GDP per capita. Need to maintain target reader orientation: no formal background, sitting alone, needs genuine rigor. Memory/continuity: carry Ch.3 pH forward-ref and Ch.4 battery forward-ref into Ch.7 as unified pedagogical touchstones. Aim: all seven chapters form a self-contained, freely available, sequential arc. Remaining call budget should sustain ~6 more calls at the current rate; target completing Ch.6 and Ch.7 in 4–5 calls with last call reserved for editing pass and frontmatter consistency if possible.
